title: Uniform exponent for a finite purely inseparable extension
statement: Let $F\subseteq E$ be a finite purely inseparable extension of fields of characteristic $p>0$ [def-pc-field-extension] [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. Then there exists an integer $e\ge0$ such that every $y\in E$ satisfies $y^{p^e}\in F$.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: IsPurelyInseparable.hasExponent_of_finiteDimensional (line 215) gives HasExponent F E; its field IsPurelyInseparable.HasExponent.has_exponent (line 55) gives an exponent e with every y^(ringExpChar F)^e in the image of F. In characteristic p>0, ringExpChar F=p, so this is the stated condition.

from.place: The finite-extension input in the ancestor route, ILO Exposé IV §3.2.3(ii): after passing to the relative separable core, the finite purely inseparable tail has bounded exponent.
